light.min.reason: 出典に暗い場所（Deep shade）への耐性の記載がないため、明るい日陰の一段下までとした

temperature.minC.quote: a night time temperatures between 55 to 65 degrees

temperature.idealC.quote: require day time temperatures of 70 to 85 degrees Fahrenheit

humidity.quote: A humidity level of 50% or greater is also preferred.

watering.growing.quote: Water them with room temperature water about every 2 to 10 days or when the orchid mix is half dry.

watering.winter.quote: During the winter months, only water the plant bimonthly or less.

tips.ja: 水のやりすぎで、ふくらんだ茎（バルブ）が根腐れする。
tips.quote: Overwatering can cause the fleshy pseudobulbs to develop root rot.
